purpose: External check of the symmetry scout only. Never read by src/: the workflow stays blind to experimental data.
labels: OpenEA Lambda-S labels (2S+1, Sigma/Pi/Delta/Phi/Gamma/H/I, g/u for homonuclear, +/- for Sigma). Spin-orbit Omega components are mapped to their dominant Lambda-S parent.
confidence: high = textbook/spectroscopic consensus; medium = photoelectron assignment plus theory; low = debated or strongly SO/MR mixed
sources: Huber & Herzberg (1979); Rienstra-Kiracofe et al., Chem. Rev. 102, 231 (2002); Merer, Annu. Rev. Phys. Chem. 40, 407 (1989) (3d oxides); individual photoelectron studies cited per entry

CO.note: CO- 2Pi is a shape resonance (anion unbound); no bound anion ground state expected

FeO.note: FeO- X 4Delta (7/2) from photoelectron spectra (Drechsler et al. 1997; Li & Wang)

NiO.note: NiO- ground state 2Pi vs 4Sigma- debated (Ramond et al. 2002)

UO.note: UO X(4) Omega=4 dominated by 5I (U2+ 5f3 7s O2-); anion assignment theoretical only
